3293-5414-5721-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5414-5721-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5414-5721-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4681-5170-5231-8292.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1339-2835-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7511.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
6495-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

364-1987-4863.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-1987-4863.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-1987-4863.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

792-1263-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

67-1676-5670-6917-7399.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-6917-7399.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Bogwater Lumaret and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Bogwater Lumaret triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-6917-7399.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-7009-7309.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-7009-7309.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1477-2558-3000-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

2366-4178-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-4178-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

3492-3609-4112-7068.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Sharuum.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Sharuum from exile to the battlefield.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

3532-5078-5901-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

567-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
567-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Soul's Attendant triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2034-5220-6650.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1247-3139-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using The Great Henge's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3951-5703-5929.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
1270-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating three tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1-1742-2428-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1742-2428-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1355-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three enchantments.
1355-2608-4499.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
178-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4790-4840.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Myr Battlesphere that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Myr Battlesphere token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Myrs, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

184-3883-5184.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
184-3883-5184.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create two Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

4063-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4063-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

751-3314-3756-3875.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

643-2380-2534.notablePrerequisites: Bloodline Keeper does not have summoning sickness.
643-2380-2534.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

972-2634-4659-4783.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, targeting Saheeli's Artistry.
Choose to have Rootha returned to the command zone instead of your hand.
Resolve the Rootha ability, copying Saheeli's Artistry, targeting Hellkite Courser.
Resolve the copy of Saheeli's Artistry, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser that is also an artifact.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, putting Rootha from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Hellkite Courser token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
Optionally, you may choose both modes of Saheeli's Artistry to create infinite tokens of any artifact(s) on the battlefield.

165-1308-3560-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one experience counter.
165-1308-3560-4050.description:
Activate Daxos by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating two */* Spirit enchantment creature tokens.
The Spirits enter the battlefield, triggering Archon of Sun's Grace twice, creating four 2/2 Pegasus creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits and/or Pegasus, adding {1}{W}{B}.
Repeat.

618-725-2785.notablePrerequisites:
Aura of Dominion attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You have attacked this turn.
618-725-2785.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Warshrieker with haste that you will sacrifice at the beginning of the next end step.
The Mardu Warshrieker token triggers, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping a copy of Mardu Warshrieker, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
